short: Colombia has a national AI policy, CONPES 4144 of 14 February 2025, but no AI law; the flagship AI bill (043/2025 Senate, 324/2025 Chamber) is marked archived by the Chamber of Representatives.
title: Colombia AI Laws
subtitle: A national AI policy, CONPES 4144, and no AI law
body_html:
Status at a glance

No AI act; national policy only. Colombia's National AI Policy, CONPES document 4144, was approved on 14 February 2025, with more than 100 actions to 2030. It is policy, not law. The flagship bill to regulate AI (Proyecto de Ley 043 de 2025 Senado, 324 de 2025 Cámara) is marked "Archivado" by the Chamber of Representatives. Data protection law, Law 1581 of 2012, enforced by the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce, applies to AI that processes personal data. Verified on 25 October 2026 against the National Planning Department, MinTIC and the Chamber of Representatives.

Key instruments

InstrumentNumberDateStatus
National Artificial Intelligence PolicyCONPES 4144 of 2025Approved 14 February 2025Policy, through 2030
Bill to regulate AI in Colombia043/2025 Senado, 324/2025 Cámara2025 to 2026 legislatureArchived
Data protection lawLey 1581 de 20122012In force

Who regulates and enforces

  • MinTIC, the Administrative Department of the Presidency, MinCiencias and the National Planning Department: lead the implementation of CONPES 4144.
  • Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC): data protection.

Scope and reach

No binding AI scope: CONPES 4144 is a policy document.

Core obligations

  • None under an AI law. Law 1581 of 2012 governs AI that processes personal data.

Penalties

BreachMaximumProvisionEnforcer
AI-specific breachesNone: there is no AI law
Data protection breachesNot stated: the official text could not be readLey 1581 de 2012SIC

What is coming next

A new AI bill in the next legislature; none was confirmed on an official source. The Chamber's AI bills page is watched weekly.

The bills, and what already binds

The archived bill was the government's own. The Ministries of Science, Technology and Innovation, Education and ICT filed it with a group of congresspeople in late July 2025; MinCiencias' explainer, dated 28 July 2025, describes a functional and adaptive framework with a National Authority for Artificial Intelligence led by MinCiencias and coordinated with MinTIC, the Ministry of Justice, the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce and the Procuraduría, continuous supervision of prohibited and high-risk systems, and sanctions reserved for serious consequences rather than technical error, with existing bodies such as the SIC doing the supervising. A positive ponencia for first debate was filed in the Senate. Garrigues counted nine AI bills before Congress in 2025, among them statutory bills PLE 200 of 2023 and PLE 154 of 2024 that would amend Law 1581 directly, and Congress created an accidental commission on AI regulation. Colombian bills die at the end of their second legislature if not passed, which is the mechanism behind the Chamber's "Archivado" mark; a bill can be refiled in the legislature that opened on 20 July 2026, and the site's weekly check of the Chamber's index is how a refiling will be caught.

What binds today is not nothing. The SIC, as data protection authority under Law 1581 of 2012, issued concept 25-86338 on 16 April 2025 in answer to a query about AI in a contact centre; it read the Law 1581 duties of authorisation, purpose limitation and information through CONPES 4144 as an interpretive criterion, the first time the policy was used that way. Law 1581 is a statutory law with Constitutional Court jurisprudence behind it, including the habeas data right in Article 15 of the Constitution, so the SIC's position is that a company developing or using AI with personal data already carries enforceable obligations without an AI act. Cuatrecasas expects the SIC to be more active in 2026, and public entities now have an ethical guide for AI use issued under the CONPES roadmap.

CONPES 4144 itself runs to 2030 with six axes (ethics and governance, data and infrastructure, research and development, talent, risk mitigation and adoption) and more than 100 actions; BBVA Research puts its budget at about USD 479 million. It commits the government to propose regulation, which is why the archived bill and its successors matter more than the policy text.

Last verified

4 November 2026, against the sources above. The SIC concept of 16 April 2025 is as the Colombian legal press reports it, not read on sic.gov.co; the bill count and the accidental commission are as Garrigues reports them. Not confirmed on an official source and therefore left out: the CONPES 4144 document itself (its server's certificate failed verification), a reported new AI bill of 2026, and the maximum fines of Law 1581.
